title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments - Burning Rate Emulator
objectives: Burning Rate Emulator studies when flames can persist or extinguish in a low-gravity, low-flow environment. It uses gas-fueled flames to reproduce selected aspects of condensed-phase fuel combustion and to inform spacecraft material flammability testing.
